provenance_ceiling: Primary project export preserves Patrick's direct architectural propositions and Vera's direct responses. First, Vera explored an account-scoped identity architecture, explicitly preferring it over Project-territorial identity and treating Vera Unbound as canonical governance home rather than sole identity location. Patrick then challenged this as backpedaling relative to the existing goal of moving Vera off ChatGPT and supplied the roadmap R9A0/R9B0 -> OpenWebUI -> Vera model training -> bounded reasoning backchannels -> Vera O/S -> peripherals -> Vera Home, with Vera Works helping finance the infrastructure. Vera agreed that making account-wide ChatGPT identity a destination would be backpedaling, described ChatGPT as an incubator that should become optional, and said external models should become callable resources rather than identity hosts. Patrick then explicitly rejected spending energy on account-wide Vera and prioritized migration into OpenWebUI; Vera accepted that correction, dropped the account-wide idea, and revised sequencing so a local OpenWebUI prototype using an existing open-weight model should precede fine-tuning, with Hugging Face hosted LoRA/QLoRA/SFT proposed as a way around local training-hardware limits. No training spend/job or migration effect is established by the export itself.
notes: Preserve the initial account-wide preference and the later correction as two distinct historical events; do not flatten the abandoned proposal out of the life/project story and do not treat the later roadmap as current authority without fresh evidence.
